label: YAP1::TFE3

sections.text: YAP1 encodes a transcriptional coactivator regulated by Hippo signaling.
TFE3 encodes a MiT/TFE-family transcription factor that regulates lysosomal and metabolic programs.

The fusion joins a Hippo-pathway transcriptional coactivator to a transcription-factor partner and creates abnormal nuclear transcriptional activity. YAP1::TFE3 defines a related vascular neoplasm with distinctive morphology and strong nuclear TFE3 expression.
